meaning:
ἀρχι-τρίκλινος, -ου, ὁ
(τρί-κλινος or -ον, a room with three couches)
the superintendent of a banquet, whose duty it was to arrange the tables and food (DB, ii, 253): Jhn.2:8-9.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: unto the governor of the feast

elsewhere.note: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.
